RepeatOf.description:
The entry a new one repeats (C.17, Part E #67): the card names it, and Replace
deletes it. `log_id` is the account's row or the guest's stored entry; none for an
entry of this same answer, which can't be replaced.
RepeatOf.title: RepeatOf

TextShown.title: TextShown

When.description:
Every field null: just now. A nullable object isn't in either provider's schema
rules, so the object is always there and its fields are null instead.

ampm.description: 'am' or 'pm' only when the person said which; null otherwise.
ampm.title: Ampm

day.description: 'today', 'yesterday', 'tomorrow', a weekday such as 'monday' (always the last one before today, never a coming one), or a date the person gave, as YYYY-MM-DD; null if they said nothing about the day. Copy a coming day as it is: it can't be logged, and the tool says so.
day.title: Day

part.description: The part of the day the person named ('this morning', 'kal raat', 'shaam ko'); null if none.
part.title: Part

time.description: The clock time the person gave, as H:MM ('7:30', '19:30'); null if they gave none. Never guess one.
time.title: Time

When.title: When

WriteWarning.description:
What in a logged entry conflicts with the profile, kept with the log row (owner,
3 Nov 2026, Part E #45). `conflict`: a rule fired, so the entry waits for the
person's confirmation; `unchecked`: ingredients the gate couldn't check, recorded
only. `left_out`: the person said at confirm that they didn't have it (the peanuts
picked out of the poha).
WriteWarning.title: WriteWarning
